% PDF/X-4 with a CMYK output intent but the blend colour space declared as DeviceRGB: overlaps will shift.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[x-4]{pdfx}
\usepackage[cmyk]{xcolor}
\usepackage{tikz}
% pdfx puts the page boxes in pagesattr and copies them to pageattr only if that is empty: start from them
\AtBeginDocument{\edef\boxesnow{\the\pdfvariable pagesattr}%
  \expandafter\pdfvariable\expandafter pageattr\expandafter{\boxesnow /Group << /S /Transparency /CS /DeviceRGB >>}}
\pagestyle{empty}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \fill[cyan] (0,0) rectangle (3,2);
  \fill[magenta,opacity=0.5] (1.5,0.5) rectangle (4.5,2.5);
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
